name: bws-secrets
description: Secret box: Claude asks for a secret with request_secret, you type it into a masked pane, it is saved outside the project, and Bash commands use it as {{secret:NAME}}. The value is read by the shell at run time and scrubbed from results, so it never reaches the transcript. /secrets lists and removes names.

secretsDir.title: Secrets folder
secretsDir.description: Folder for the saved values, one <project>.env file per working directory. Empty (default): ~/.claude/bws-secrets. Keep it outside your projects.
